text: In the New Mexico desert near Alamogordo, police find a catatonic little girl beside a ravaged trailer, a store owner dead in his cellar, and a strange pulsating sound. A father and daughter who study ants trace the killings to [giant ants mutated by the first atomic bomb test|origin|monsters people made], [hunting for human flesh|wants|feeding on the living]. Two young queens have flown, and the search ends under Los Angeles in [more than 700 miles of storm drains|images|wild and lonely places], where two missing boys are trapped and Harold warns that [no one can predict what comes next|ending|the evil lives on].
